mentions.name: Subtitled reading language-learning app
mentions.description: This app is an early-stage language-learning tool focused on what the builder calls "subtitled reading" — interleaving lines of text in the source and target language. It is similar in spirit to Fluir but less far along.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a similar thing but mine is not as far along, and slightly more focused on what I call "subtitled reading" (interleaving source and target language lines of text).
mentions.author: gr__or
